verdict.rationale: The error-grouping docs only describe default grouping (by error class, file and line of the top in-project frame), show the grouping reason, and say vaguely that "a range of custom options are available" to tailor grouping. That is an adjacent fingerprint-configuration capability, not a documented ability to merge duplicate errors or split a wrongly collapsed one. No evidence in the pack shows merge or split actions on errors.
